function graphFit(placed): GraphFit

Defined in: experiments/docs/arch-scene.ts:288

Fit the camera to the real graph radius — a deep manifest (outer rings past ~60 units) left the default pose sitting INSIDE the tree, which rendered nodes as giant blobs instead of a legible radial map. dist = r/sin(fov/2) with ~20% margin frames the whole graph.
